damage.source: GOB 947 stores an instant viral health modifier, Function 0, bounds 62 and 300. The client evaluator at 6251802e–6251804e multiplies the interval by a 15-bit draw and shifts right 15 before adding the minimum, so the largest reachable base is 299.
damage.runtime: The normal health landing path uses AbilityValues.TryRandomValue before the existing Viral Damage influence and defender Viral Resistance.
damage.test: PacketLossSamplesTheStoredViralRange checks 62/181/299 at draws 0/16384/32767. PacketLossLandsTypedViralDamageOnlyAfterTheSelectedOpponentContest exercises the live PvP hit, deflection and resistance pipeline.

source-parity.source: The shipped 62–300 bound is corroborated by the explicit Function 0 math in research/protocol/stat-linked-caps-native.txt. The emulator still uses its own random stream.
source-parity.runtime: The previous generic damage interval is superseded on this row by the shipped template and retained evaluator.
source-parity.test: PacketLossSamplesTheStoredViralRange supplies an obsolete legacy interval and verifies that it cannot override the source bounds.

targeting.source: GOB 947 stores one selected target, 20 m, Hacker Style and viral TestFunction 2.
targeting.runtime: Before cost, the ordinary request must bind an owned/loaded ability to a live in-range opponent in sight and matching the presented spawn. Landing revalidates the original enemy and range before a single-target viral contest.
targeting.test: PacketLossRequiresTheOriginalLiveSelectedEnemy exercises the unloaded and wrong-style refusals, missing/ally/blocked/out-of-range selection and changed spawn/range/load at completion for the shared Packet Loss path. PacketLossLandsTypedViralDamageOnlyAfterTheSelectedOpponentContest verifies the actual hit/deflect path.

controls.source: GOB 947 stores a 10 s Rooted state (99) and no immunity marker.
controls.runtime: The landed Rooted state prevents movement without disabling abilities or granting control immunity. It expires independently of the direct hit.
controls.test: PacketLossUsesItsStoredProcThresholdOnTheLandedEffect verifies the movement and ability gates and their release on expiry.

proc.source: GOB 947 stores a 0.1 chance on that state modifier.
proc.runtime: A successful viral hit rolls independently for Rooted. A deflection runs neither damage nor state.
proc.test: PacketLossUsesItsStoredProcThresholdOnTheLandedEffect checks equality refuses and a roll immediately below 0.1 procs. The real deflect test confirms no state is attached.

behavior-tests.source: The 2 s cast costs 20 IS and starts 4 s own and shared group 682 reuse.
behavior-tests.runtime: The normal cast/cost path and existing catalog timer handle the cast, independent of the state draw.
behavior-tests.test: PacketLossRequiresTheOriginalLiveSelectedEnemy checks cast reservation, cost and timer after admission and no debit on refusal. PacketLossLandsTypedViralDamageOnlyAfterTheSelectedOpponentContest verifies group 682. Sibling stock bootstrap exercises ordinary framing in the grouped fixture.
